03 / ACADEMIC PERFORMANCE

Understanding achievement.

How are students performing academically?

Missouri's statewide assessment, MAP, measures achievement in English language arts, mathematics, science and social studies.

What does “proficient” mean? Proficient or Advanced means a tested student reached one of the two higher achievement levels reported by Missouri's Department of Elementary and Secondary Education (DESE).

2025 MSIP aggregate results · only three reportable charter networks per subject. Other networks have unavailable components, not zero proficiency. These values are kept separate from the grade-specific comparisons below. View detailed results and sources.

04 / ACADEMIC GROWTH

A different view of progress.

How many schools received Missouri's academic growth Target designation?

Achievement describes a level reached. The Annual Performance Report (APR) uses a separate growth measure and eligibility rules.

APR growth target attainment describes the share of eligible buildings designated Target. It is not the percentage of individual students whose scores improved. These comparisons are descriptive and do not establish a sponsorship effect.

How growth eligibility is defined

Only building-level 2025 ALL growth measures with positive possible points, reported earned points and a designation are eligible. Target is the exact designation; On-Track does not count as Target. Participation records remain eligible. One of the 14 sponsored buildings is ineligible or unreported per subject. District records are not added to building totals.

BUILT ON EVIDENCE

Numbers you can trace.

A year belongs with every number

Preliminary 2025–26 enrollment, 2025 outcomes and a June 2026 directory describe different periods. None represents finalized 2026–27 enrollment.

Unavailable does not mean zero

A source may suppress a value or leave it unreported. We preserve that distinction and never reconstruct missing counts.

Different measures, different groups

FRL uses January membership; enrollment uses K–12 records; MAP uses reportable tests; APR growth uses eligible buildings.
